summary: This RFC proposes a service that helps people work out mailbox addresses for hosts outside the ARPA Internet, which can be reached through relay hosts using UUCP, CSNET, MAILNET, BITNET and similar mail. Anyone can use it. It asks for discussion.

eli5.summary: A helper tells you which route to use to get a letter to someone on a different mail network.

questions: what is the network mail path service
how to address mail to uucp or bitnet hosts
